column3: \t事件は、それだけで収まらなかった。
column4: The incident did not end there.

column3: \t気絶していた美樹が目をさます、ビクビク痙攣しておかしい。
column4: Miki, who had been unconscious, wakes up trembling and convulsing strangely.

column3: \t魔王に覚醒しかけている、ヒラミレモンを無理に食べさせても駄目
column4: She is on the verge of awakening as the Demon King; forcing her to eat Hiramiremon doesn't work.
It can no longer be stopped.

column3: \tせっかく人類の危機がさったと思ったのに、魔王が覚醒してしまうと
column4: Just when they thought the crisis for humanity was over, the Demon King awakens.

column3: \tまたふりだし、いやもっとひどい事になる
column4: It returns to the starting point, or rather, it becomes even worse.

column3: \t美樹は鎖でベッドに縛り付けられている、とっても苦しそう
column4: Miki is chained to the bed and looks very distressed.

column3: \t早く対策を取らねばいけない状態。
\t魔王を殺せばなんとかなるかもしれないが、美樹を殺すなんて出来ない
column4: Maybe killing the Demon King could solve it, but they cannot kill Miki.

column3: \tかといって魔王が動き出したら大変
column4: On the other hand, if the Demon King starts moving, it will be disastrous.

column3: \t何か対策は・・と考えているが、もう時間が無い
column4: Thinking if there's any countermeasure... but time is running out.

column3: \t\t魔王は消滅しない、もし死んだらどこかで次の誰かが魔王になる
column4: The Demon King does not disappear; if he dies, someone else somewhere becomes the next Demon King.

column3: \t\t魔王は自ら魔王を別の物に引き継げる
column4: The Demon King can pass on his title to another by himself.

column3: \t\tただし、魔王を引き継げる者はほんの一部の特異な能力の者だけ
column4: However, only a very few with special abilities can inherit the Demon King.

column3: \t\t先代魔王もそれを探し、誰も見つからなかったので異世界の娘を
column4: The previous Demon King searched for such a person, but finding none, chose a girl from another world.
He had no choice but to select her.
